meta.source: https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/ (live site CSS, logo file and icons, read 24 Nov 2026)

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: site white. Night Ledger: the site's own hero and footer navy.

tokens.name: ground-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section band, so long pages read as a ledger of rows. Never place two ground-alt bands next to each other.

tokens.name: ground-sunk
tokens.usage: Input fields and quiet wells. Source: the site's form field grey.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text on ground, ground-alt, ground-sunk and ember-wash. 14:1 on white, 18:1 on night.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on ground, ground-alt and ground-sunk. 5.8:1 on white, 6.4:1 on night. Source: --color-body and the footer grey.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The brand orange (--color-primary). Fills for primary buttons, the Pulse Line, stat columns and the node dot. As text only at 24px or larger on white (3.9:1). On night it passes as text at any size (4.7:1).

tokens.name: ember-ink
tokens.usage: Orange for small text: links, eyebrows, inline highlights. Light uses --color-primary-9 (5.4:1 on white, 5.0:1 on ember-wash). Night uses --color-terciary (8.0:1 on night).

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for ember buttons. Carries on-ember-deep text.

tokens.name: ember-glow
tokens.usage: Lighter orange (--color-terciary). Second series in charts, highlights on night bands, the headline accent word on night.

tokens.name: ember-wash
tokens.usage: Warm tint behind callouts, the hero form card on light, and selected rows. Source: --color-primary-alta.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: The round tile colour baked into the site's icons. Use only behind icons and stat halos, never behind text.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Deep navy for dark bands in the light theme: hero, CTA band, footer. Text on it is on-night.

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Footer base and the copyright strip, one step below night.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and the form panel sitting on a night band.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night, night-deep and night-raised (18:1).

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: White plate behind the logo on night grounds and in the dark theme. The logo was drawn for white, so it always sits on white.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night bands: footer links, small print (6.5:1 on night).

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Label colour on an ember fill. Night ink on orange reads 4.7:1, where white only reaches 3.9:1. This pairing is the signature Aviteus button.

tokens.name: on-ember-deep
tokens.usage: Label colour on ember-deep (hover state): white at 5.4:1.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The blue of the logo's rising bars, sampled from the logo file. Chart series next to ember (blue and orange stay apart for colour-blind readers). On night use it only as a fill under on-night text.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The wordmark colour inside the logo. Reference only: do not restyle the logo with it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card outlines and input borders at rest. Decorative only, never the sole sign of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input border on hover and the rule under table headers. Meets 3:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring with a 2px ground gap. Light: night on white 18:1 and on ember 4.7:1. Night: ember-glow on night 8:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Source --color-success. Fails as text on white (2.6:1): use as a dot or fill with ink text and always a word next to it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Source --color-warning. Use as a fill with ink text and a word. Never alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Source --color-danger. 4.0:1 on white: below AA for small text. Pair with an icon and a word; error text itself uses ink.

tokens.name: icon-ink
tokens.usage: The red-orange baked into the copied site icons. Reference only, so new artwork can match. Never use it for UI text or fills.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only. One per page. Highlight one phrase in ember (on light) or ember-glow (on night).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Landing page section openers and the CTA band.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, step titles, footer column titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: You want numbers you can trust and advice you can use.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a hero or section title. Max 2 sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We reconcile banks, handle receipts and flag issues early.
styles.usage: All running text. Max line length 68 characters.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The small line above a section title. Always uppercase, always ember-ink, always led by the node dot.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Hero stats and the big number in a Stat Column. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts, prices and percentages inside text, tables and cards.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Dates, deadlines, form numbers (SA100, CT600), reference codes and opening hours.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap. The 4px base unit from the source site.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between eyebrow dot and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input inner padding (vertical), small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default stack gap, mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title block and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (matches the site's 120px rhythm).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, the logo plate.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Large panels: hero form, newsletter band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the menu toggle (the site's 30px pill, made true).

cut.note: The Notch: one corner cut at 45 degrees, taken from the angled tops of the logo's rising bars. Always the top-right corner. Applied with clip-path.

tokens.name: cut-s
tokens.usage: Badges, deadline tags.

tokens.name: cut-m
tokens.usage: Service cards, feature cards, stat columns.

tokens.name: cut-l
tokens.usage: Hero media frame and the CTA band.

stroke.note: Line weights for the Pulse Line and hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-pulse
tokens.usage: The Pulse Line, input focus border and step connectors.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The stat column cap and the hero accent rule.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Cards on hover and the hero form panel. Never on resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Edge of the white logo plate.
